Good - the current regex already handles zero-prefixed versions correctly. Now let me check what happens with `3.4.5-rc.1+0009.dev` - according to semver.org, build metadata allows leading zeros, so this should match (and it does).

Now let me look at the prerelease part more carefully. The current regex has:
```
(?P<prerelease>
    (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
    (\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
)
```

This means numeric identifiers in prerelease can be "0" or "[1-9][0-9]*", which aligns with semver.org spec that says "When major, minor, and patch are equal, a pre-release version has lower precedence than a normal version." And "Precedence MUST be calculated by separating the identifier into numeric and alphanumeric identifiers."
